name: Hanabusa Maya
source:
The current student council president of the school the protagonist goes to. Due to her personality which doesn't allow for compromise when it comes to getting results, she is called a sadist by those around her. Since Maya is fundamentally a sadist, she does not show any interest in anyone who is not fun to toy with.

In any case, she is a perfectionist who hates losing, but is a kind person who is able to show compassion towards others. She doesn't drop her cool behavior for anyone except for the person with whom she decides let her guard down. With this person, her playful and mischievous side is shown. The complex with her is that you can be laughing while also being scared.
